items.title: Coherent Jumps 13% as Optical Stocks Extend AI Rebound; Lumentum Surges 11%, Applied Optoelectronics Rises 4%
items.summary: Optical stocks are bouncing back from last week's AI selloff, but the gains are far from equal. Cash burn, a pending Marvell deal, and a stark analyst split explain why one name pulls ahead while another lags.

items.title: Broadcom Faltered for a Year, Dropping Nearly 20%: This Wall Street Analyst Team Says 140% Gains Materialize Within 12 Months
items.summary: Broadcom posted record results while its stock slid, and the culprit is not revenue. Margin pressure and a $63 billion financing structure have spooked investors, yet one analyst still sees a path far above the crowd.

items.title: Credo Stock Has a Powerful Growth Story, but Is It Already Priced In?
items.summary: Credo just posted triple-digit revenue growth and its eighth straight earnings beat, yet the stock lost a third of its value in a month. Two big customers and one valuation gap might explain why the market and our model disagree.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Major Indexes Soar as Market Looks to Rebound from Last Week’s Losses; Nvidia Plunges as Company Investigates CEO Huang
items.summary: Major stock indexes are sharply higher early Monday after last week’s volatile trading, while Nvidia shares are sliding following news that raises uncertainty about the chipmaker’s leadership.

items.title: The Biggest AI Opportunity May Be Hiding Outside the GPU Market
items.summary: A record quarter should have sent this chip giant soaring. Instead, the stock sank for a week straight while Wall Street analysts kept piling in. What do they see in custom silicon that the sellers are missing?

items.title: ETFs Bought $13.1 Million of Marvell (MRVL) on Thursday
items.summary: Forty-four ETFs bought Marvell shares while 19 sold on Nov. 5.

items.title: Marvell Stock Fell 58% From Its Record. History Says What Followed Its Last 4 Drops This Deep.
items.summary: Two of the chip designer's past rebounds from a crash this deep took over five years. Is this one different?

items.title: NVDA, PLTR, QCOM, SPCX, MRVL: Why Retail Traders Couldn’t Take Their Eyes Off These Stocks Last Week
items.summary: The week was marked by developments, including a probe into Nvidia’s CEO, strong results from Palantir, and Musk’s ambitious revenue goals.
